title: Texas Standard for Oct. 7, 2026: Program looks to give RGV high school dropouts new opportunities
summary: The Rio Grande Valley has the largest concentration of adults who didn’t finish high school out of anywhere in the country. This has wide-ranging impacts on families and the local...
content: The Rio Grande Valley has the largest concentration of adults who didn't finish high school out of anywhere in the country. This has wide-ranging impacts on families and the local economy. A new adult charter high school system with campuses across the Valley aims to fill that educational need. It's an idea that could soon be replicated elsewhere in Texas. Source
